name: Jyoti Ma
reason: Too thin. She has no website of her own; her organisation, the Center for Sacred Studies (centerforsacredstudies.org, robots.txt read), runs programmes led by other facilitators. Her own items there are fireside chats inside a shared membership, one video about the centre on its channel, and a 1998 book (An Angel Called My Name) with no ISBN on any page we may use. Also note: her only Esalen workshops were on psilocybin (Entheowheel, 2021), so she may be one for the owner to hold anyway.
